subject: general
question: A sum of Rs. 1,800 gives a simple interest of Rs. 360 in 3 years 4 months. The rate of interest per annum is:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal Rs. 1,800 

SI = Rs. 360 

Time = 3 years 4 months

**Formula used:**

S.I = (P × T × R)/100

Here, P = Principal, T = Time (in years), R = Rate of interest

**Calculation:**

3 years and 4 months = (3 + 4/12) years = 3(1)/(3)years

Let the rate of interest be R

According to the question,

⇒ 360 = (1800 × 3(1)/(3) × R)/100 

⇒ 360 = (1800 × 10/3 × R)/100

⇒ 360 = 6000R/100

⇒ 360 = 60R

⇒ R = 360/60 = 6

So, Rate of interest = 6%

**∴ The rate of interest per annum is 6%.**
